entities.name: Marion De Vries

entities.summary: Marion De Vries was an American lawyer, politician, and jurist who served as a United States representative from California, a Member and President of the Board of General Appraisers and an Associate Judge and later Presiding Judge of the United States Court of Customs Appeals.
